title: Day Trading Plan
description: A complete-beginner path to building and following a real day trading plan — market mechanics, reading charts, risk and money management, and the psychology and discipline that make a plan actually stick.

changelog.notes: Initial release: 29 decks covering trading fundamentals, technical analysis basics, risk and money management, trading psychology, and building a written trading plan.
Adds Learn more articles (18, each with a worked example) for the glossary terms; tapping a term now offers "Read the full explanation".
